description: Records can be retrieved through their primary slug value; nullable lookup reports no match, while strict lookup normalizes a missing record to a record-not-found error.

cases.expected_output:
workflow=lookup_by_slug
selector=a-post-title-b
found=yes
record_id=2
record_title=A Post Title B

workflow=lookup_by_slug
selector=not a real record
found=no
record_id=<null>
record_title=<null>

workflow=lookup_by_slug_or_error
selector=a-post-title-b
found=yes
record_id=2
record_title=A Post Title B

workflow=lookup_by_slug_or_error
selector=not a real record
error=record_not_found
